title: Worksheet 4: The Builder Pattern
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: The Builder pattern helps create a complicated object one step at a time, instead of trying to set up everything with one giant instruction. Imagine a character creator in a game where a player can choose a hair color, a hat, a cape, and a pet, but none of these choices are required. Without a builder, the programmer might need a single instruction with 4 slots that must all be filled in the right order, even for a plain character with no extras. With a builder, the code reads like a short list of steps: start a character, add a red cape, add a pet cat, and then finish. Steps the player skipped are simply left out, and calling "finish" produces the completed character. Because each option is its own named step, a new option such as boots just becomes one more step, rather than a fifth slot that every existing instruction must be updated to include.

questions.text: The Builder pattern creates a complicated object:
distractors: All at once in a single giant instruction
Only by copying an existing object
By deleting parts of other objects

questions.text: In the character creator example, which choices are required?
According to the paragraph, what does calling "finish" do?
A player wants a character with only a blue hat and nothing else. Using the builder steps described in the paragraph, which is the best description of the code?
questions.correct: Start a character, add the blue hat, then finish
distractors: Fill in all four slots, then finish
Finish first, then start a character and add the hat
Add a hat, a cape, a pet, and a hair color, then finish

questions.text: The game designer wants to add boots as a fifth option. According to the paragraph, why is this easier with a builder?
questions.correct: Boots just become one more named step, so existing instructions do not need to be updated
distractors: The builder automatically invents new options
The player must choose boots every time
Boots replace the cape, so nothing else changes
